caption: The drawing depicts a central figure, who appears to be a person riding a brown horse. The rider is wearing a blue coat, light-colored pants, and a brown hat. To the right of the rider, there are two animals—a white goat and a brown dog. The background is filled with large floral patterns in shades of pink, red, and green, with the flowers and leaves surrounding the central scene. The entire composition has a tapestry-like appearance, with visible folds and creases in the material, suggesting it is either drawn or printed on fabric. The overall color palette includes muted browns, beiges, pinks, reds, greens, and blues. The scene is set against a beige background, with the floral motif extending to all corners of the drawing.
title: Chintz Square
